newsitem.title: USA: Peerless to probe strategic alternatives.
newsitem.headline: Peerless to probe strategic alternatives.

text.p: Peerless Manufacturing Co said Monday it had retained Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc to conduct a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value.
It said alternatives to be analyzed would include potential acquisitions, restructurings, mergers, sales, strategic alliances or business combinations.
"Our purpose is to analyze our position and evaluate possible alternatives in the best interests of our stockholders," the company said in a statement Monday evening.
"We may conclude that the best course of action is to continue our business as we have in the past, or to reorganize or restructure it in some way."
Peerless makes separators and filters for the petroleum, natural gas, petrochemical and electric utility industries.
